key_facts: Chancellor John Healey is set to unveil his first Budget on Wednesday; there have been very few leaks about its contents.
Government borrowing costs are at "historic highs", putting Healey's tax and spending plans under close scrutiny.
BBC News spoke to individuals on different incomes about their finances; the article is a collection of personal testimonies, not an analysis of Budget measures.

Robert Portlock, 29, earns £22,000 and says a small flat in his area would cost about two-thirds of his monthly wage; he pays £750 a month on car finance, insurance, fuel and tax. He wants fuel duty and income tax cut or the personal allowance raised to about £16,000 (from £12,570).
The main UK fuel duty rate has been frozen at 57.95p per litre since March 2011.
importance_reason: Pre-Budget context for a major fiscal event with high borrowing costs, but the article is a human-interest collection of testimonies rather than a source of new policy facts.
market_link: Budget tax and spending decisions amid historic-high government borrowing costs may affect gilt yields and sterling; the article itself gives no specific market data.

key_facts: Apple says it will replace iPhone Duo handsets that have developed screen problems, just days after the smartphone went on sale.
Photos posted by social media users show lines on the screens of the Duo, Apple's first foldable device, which starts at £1,999 ($2,668) in the UK.
Apple said it is aware of 'an issue impacting the inner display on a small number' of units and asked affected users to contact the company for a replacement.
Some owners also reported cracks along the centre crease of the screen and a crunching noise when opening the device. The inner display is 7.6 inches (19.3 cm).
importance_reason: Локальная корпоративная новость о дефекте продукта с ограниченным прямым рыночным эффектом; возможен репутационный эффект для Apple.

key_facts: A $300 billion 'debt wall' is looming over private-equity-backed companies.
Software firms account for about a third of the risky corporate loans due in 2028 and 2029.
importance_reason: Large refinancing wall in leveraged loans with sector concentration in software; relevant to credit markets but no decision or sharp market move reported.
market_link: Refinancing pressure on leveraged PE-backed borrowers could raise default risk and weigh on leveraged loan and high-yield credit prices, especially in software.
